page_title: GET 1-2 MAL | Getafe v Mallorca 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van Der Heyden S. Shoulder Injury

commentary.text: 90+15' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Jaime Mata (Getafe) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
90+3' 1 - 2 Goal! Manu Morlanes plays a long ball to Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer low into the middle of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 1:2.
90' 14 additional min. will be played.
90' 1 - 1 Goal! Antonio Raillo gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) glances a header into the net. 1:1.
90' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90' The corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared away by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
90' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.
89' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

88' Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
84' It looks like David Soria (Getafe) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Jose Bordalas Jimenez replaces him with Daniel Fuzato.
77' David Soria (Getafe) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
74' David Soria (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
73' This is a yellow card! Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
73' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Cyle Larin (Mallorca) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Djene trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe).
71' Here's the change. Alberto Risco Alcantara leaves the pitch and Jordi Martin (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
70' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) replaces Sergi Darder.
70' Substitution. Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) replaces Javier Llabres.
67' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Oscar Rodriguez and he is replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
67' Substitution. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) in, Luis Milla out.
65' Mallorca fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
65' Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Mallorca will take a corner kick.
65' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).

64' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but David Soria thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

60' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Ivan Cuellar makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
59' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is caught offside!
57' That will be all from Antonio Sanchez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
57' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Nemanja Radonjic is replaced by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
57' Here comes a substitution. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Abdon Prats.
56' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
56' Getafe take a short corner kick.
50' Javier Aguirre is stunned as referee Victor Garcia shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
48' 1 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Oscar Rodriguez sets up Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
40' Good chance! Mason Greenwood (Getafe) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
37' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
36' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece. Getafe have a free kick from a promising distance.

33' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, David Soria anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

31' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
30' Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
25' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
21' Wow, what an escape. Jaime Mata (Getafe) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
18' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
17' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
17' Omar Alderete (Getafe) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' The free kick into the penalty area from Luis Milla (Getafe) is cleared.
13' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe will take a free kick near the side line.
7' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

6' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
6' Ivan Cuellar had to pull off an exquisite save to thwart a knuckleball from Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe), even though it only went towards the middle of the target.
4' A pass by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Victor Garcia will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
